text.text: Cisco UCS E-Series Servers are next-generation, general-purpose Intel x86 64-bit blade servers designed for use in Cisco Integrated Services Routers Generation 2. Balancing simplicity, performance, reliability, and power efficiency, the new servers provide a virtualization-ready compute infrastructure in a branch-office environment while maintaining lean branch-office architecture.
